matches.rationale: The GT concerns the operation p⊙_t q being incorrectly defined/expressed, undermining later results. Findings 3, 4, and 5 all directly engage with the ⊙_t (and its generalization ⊙_{l,k}) operation's foundational properties (group structure, zero element at t) and show how these flaws invalidate downstream theorems (3.3, 3.5, and the group claim near Def. 2.6), matching the GT's described mechanism even though the symptoms surface in different proofs (R3).
